title: fix(fields): cap multi-value lookup cells at 3 chips + a "+N" overflow chip
body:
## Problem

A multi-value lookup cell rendered EVERY referenced record as its own chip inside a `flex-wrap` container. In a production grid (排班计划, a scheduling list), one row's 作业对象 column referenced 60+ work objects — the chips wrapped one per line and a single row grew to several screens of height, blowing the page layout apart.

The uncapped array branch lives in `LookupCellRenderer`, which every read surface resolves through `getCellRenderer('lookup')`: grid, record detail sections, related lists, gallery, kanban, report and dashboard tables were all affected.

## Fix

The array branch of `LookupCellRenderer` now renders the first `MAX_LOOKUP_CELL_CHIPS` (3) chips and collapses the rest into one muted `+N` chip — the same cap `UserCellRenderer` has always applied to its avatar stack in the same file.

- The `+N` chip's `title` lists the hidden references' display names, resolved through the same option → resolved-name → opaque-id path as the visible chips, so the collapsed set stays reachable on hover.
- The visible chips keep their per-record links (#4336) and their resolution order.
- Cells with 3 or fewer references render byte-identically to before.
- Display-only: edit paths (grid inline edit via `FieldEditWidget`, detail inline edit and forms via `LookupField`) read the raw field value and are untouched.

## Verification

- New regression test `lookupCellOverflow.test.tsx`: 60 values → 3 chips + `+57`; hidden names on the overflow chip's `title`; no overflow chip at ≤3 values; primitive-id arrays capped the same way.
- Full `packages/fields` suite (112 files / 1843 tests), `plugin-form` suite (64 files / 638 tests), and the grid + detail inline-edit suites (93 tests) all green.
- Browser-verified against a live ObjectStack showcase app with a 60-reference `f_lookups` record: read view renders `ZTLW-A.1 ZTLW-A.2 ZTLW-A.3 +57` on one line; inline edit expands all 60 values and a save round-trip keeps all 60; the edit dialog shows all 60 and saving a name-only change leaves the reference set intact; create-form picking works and stores exactly the picked ids.

Changeset included (`@object-ui/fields` patch).
